reviewer: Codex, independent. Did not author the candidate and did not read any concurrent reviewer.
summary: The live DR-122 row and carried source text are exact; preview SARIF remains dropped, G17 remains inapplicable, Run/Finding recipes remain parked, and renderer/D9 authority is host-owned. Acceptance nevertheless fails at 1 blocker and 2 SHOULD-FIX: no closed versioned OpenSIP SARIF field schema exists, FC-LOSS lacks the dropped-preview ride, and the purported exact D9 fixture omits the conditional committed-Run boundary while conflating output failure with refusal.

obligationReview.reason: Preview applicability is explicitly NONE for SARIF; analyze/doctor/help/version are named as human+json only, and later analyze applicability is conditional rather than advertised.
The base SARIF version and property-bag roots do not constitute a closed OpenSIP machine/schema/version contract.
Parity/loss cannot be adjudicated without a field schema, and the loss fixture has no lawful preview standing.

The non-authority law correctly excludes renderer control over policy, evidence, sealed termination, D9, and exit; fixture outcomes still conflate host output failure with authority-injection refusal.
The correct D9 ID/class/code/exit are cited, but the exact conditional committed-Run boundary and host-finalization-only scope are omitted.

blockers.title: machineSurface does not define the stable machine/schema/version contract that OBL-2 and the parity goldens require
detail: The proposed surface fixes the base label 'SARIF 2.1.0', says to use native fields 'where available', and names only the container paths run.properties.opensip and result.properties.opensip. It never defines an OpenSIP projection-schema identifier/version, the exact extension keys and value types, requiredness/cardinality, which preserved value belongs at run versus result scope, or the exact native-field mapping.

Consequently Run ID, Finding ID, Coverage, verdict, truncation, and artifact references can be placed in different SARIF-native fields or differently shaped opensip property objects by two renderers, with both satisfying the prose. schemaStability cannot make an unspecified representation stable, and a consumer cannot distinguish an additive successor from an incompatible interpretation.

FC-PARITY and FC-LOSS name desired effects but provide no structured expected projection or closed mapping against which a golden can pass or fail. The pinned V1 projectionParity supplies representation modes and namespace roots, not the missing V2 extension schema, so citing it does not close this contract's OBL-2 gap.
blockers.impact: The candidate is not implementable or independently testable as one machine surface. OBL-2 is unanswered substantively and OBL-3's parity/loss result is renderer-dependent, leaving the primary DR-122 contract open even though preview advertisement is correctly dropped.
blockers.minimumRepair: Define a tool-neutral, versioned OpenSIP SARIF projection schema: exact native mappings; exact opensip run/result property keys, types, cardinalities, and requiredness; artifact/truncation representation; unknown/additive/breaking-version behavior; and structured golden inputs/expected outputs. Canonical Run/Finding IDs must enter this mapping as opaque values supplied by their owner, with activation still riding DR-006; defining their projection locations must not define their recipes.

shouldFix.title: The SARIF-specific loss fixture has no inactive/conditional standing after preview SARIF and G17 were dropped
shouldFix.detail: FC-PARITY explicitly says it is INACTIVE for preview and activates only after a later DR-006 recipe close restores an advertisement. FC-LOSS exercises SARIF's namespaced property bag but has no conditionality or standing at all. Because fixtureClasses has no enclosing activation rule, FC-LOSS reads as presently required even while the subject says no preview command advertises SARIF and G17 is dropped/inapplicable. Treating it as active would silently revive the very SARIF parity surface the candidate says is absent; treating it as dormant relies on an unstated exception.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Give every fixture class an explicit preview standing and owning ride. Mark FC-LOSS inactive on the same advertisement/DR-006 condition as FC-PARITY; retain FC-NONAUTH and FC-OUTFAIL only at the non-SARIF host-projection scopes they actually cover. A future G17 ride activates only after an explicit advertised surface exists.

shouldFix.title: The claimed exact output-failure golden drops D9's conditional Run-preservation boundary and conflates ordinary renderer failure with refusal
detail: The pinned D9 golden has commandKind=any and preserves a Run only if an authoritative Run was already committed; its projectionScope is host-finalization-only. The candidate instead states without qualification that a required serialization/atomic-write failure 'preserves the settled Run', and FC-OUTFAIL repeats that as the exact golden. Help/version or another command with no committed Run must not acquire a fictitious Run/RunId to satisfy this wording.

FC-NONAUTH groups an ordinary renderer failure with renderer-chosen D9 and rewritten termination, then says all 'refuse'. A required serialization/atomic-write failure is not the same negative case: the host applies operational-failed / OUTPUT.SERIALIZATION_FAILED and derives exit 4. Authority-injection attempts may be rejected, but the expected outcomes must be separate.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Carry the D9 boundary exactly: host-finalization-only; if a Run was already committed, preserve its identity and sealed termination; otherwise no Run identity is created; public termination is operational-failed with OUTPUT.SERIALIZATION_FAILED and exit derives from classToExitCode. Split ordinary output failure from renderer authority-injection negatives and give each an exact expected outcome.

attacksAttemptedAndFailed: Live-row attack failed: the unique live | DR-122 | row is byte-identical to rowVerbatim and its acceptance cell is exact.
Preview-advertisement attack failed: previewLiveApplicability is NONE and FC-APPLIC names human+json only for analyze/doctor/help/version.
Identity-recipe attack failed: canonical Run/Finding values remain opaque and explicitly ride DR-006; no derivation or fingerprint algorithm is minted.

Renderer-authority attack failed at the normative-law level: nonAuthority forbids renderer effects on policy, evidence, sealed HostTermination, D9, and exit, and requiredOutputFailure assigns the cited failure to the host.
Positive-authority attack failed: status is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, seal recommendation is DO-NOT-SEAL, and implementation authorization is expressly denied.
Sibling/lock attack failed: the candidate treats the D9 output golden only at its file-08-authoritative scope, leaves the DR-111 matrix join proposed, and makes no lock producible.

COORD-drift falsity attack failed: the recorded historical bytes are reproducible in repository history and the live file is an append-only extension; every cited D-002/D-077/D-086/D-092 proposition exists at the recorded digest.

verdictStatement: This independent review rejects sarif-projection-contract.v1 at the measured subject digest. It does not mark DR-122 SATISFIED, does not apply or seal the subject, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
